analisis-informes.title: Comparative Analysis of Technical Reports (Phase 5)
analisis-informes.description: The Iberian blackout of April 28, 2025 generated technical documentation unprecedented in European electrical system history. In the months following the incident, four institutional actors published technical reports with partially contradictory conclusions about the collapse causes.

conclusiones.title: Conclusions (Chapter 9)
conclusiones.description: The analysis developed in the eight preceding chapters permits formulation of a set of first-order technical, regulatory, and methodological conclusions. The collapse of the Iberian electrical system on April 28, 2025 was not an unpredictable accident: it was the crystallization of structural vulnerabilities that available analytical frameworks were not designed to detect.

resiliencia-futuro.title: Resilience and Future of Electrical Systems (Chapter 7)
resiliencia-futuro.description: The structural lesson of April 28, 2025 resides not in the collapse itself, but in the class of vulnerability it revealed. Forensic analysis demonstrated that the voltage zero was neither an active power reserve failure nor an operational error: it was the terminal manifestation of fundamental incompatibility between the physics of a system dominated by inverters and a technical-regulatory framework designed for synchronous networks.

uso-ia.title: Discussion on the Use of Artificial Intelligence in the TFG (Chapter 8)
uso-ia.description: The development of this Final Degree Project has taken place in an atypical methodological context: the simultaneous occurrence, during 2024–2026, of a systemic crisis in the Iberian electrical system and accelerated transformation in natural language processing tools. The availability of Large Language Models (LLMs) capable of processing hundreds of pages of technical documents in minutes coincided with the publication of four primary technical reports on the event. This chapter documents transparently how these tools have been integrated into the workflow, what specific tasks they have performed, what systematic errors were detected and corrected, and what epistemological reflection emerges for research in engineering.
